description: ICyou - a Fabric Minecraft mod for 1.21.1

mods.name: ICyou
mods.description: ICyou adds a working CCTV surveillance system to Minecraft: place cameras, view their live feed on screens and terminals, cycle channels, and track mobs via network blips.

releases.notes:

* Auto-upload releases to CurseForge by @MatissJurevics in https://github.com/MatissJurevics/ICyou/pull/2
* Fix screen camera feed orientation by @MatissJurevics in https://github.com/MatissJurevics/ICyou/pull/3
* Raise camera feed frame rate to 16 FPS by @MatissJurevics in https://github.com/MatissJurevics/ICyou/pull/4
* Add per-terminal camera streaming (read-only HTTP) by @MatissJurevics in https://github.com/MatissJurevics/ICyou/pull/5
* Theme stream web UI; bump to 0.2.0 by @MatissJurevics in https://github.com/MatissJurevics/ICyou/pull/6


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MatissJurevics/ICyou/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0
